searchText: Is the EF planning to kill the portal nodes it is operating? I don't know if they have decided yet. I would expect <@261161007982968833> to have some new information by next week This would definitely affect decision by clients If you're looking for early hints, my understanding is that geth is still working on integrating their Portal support. But it's not a commitment and the situation is fluid, of course
